using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Net;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Garnet.common.Tests
{
    public class FormatTests
    {
        private readonly Mock<ILogger> _mockLogger;

        public FormatTests()
        {
            _mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();
        }

        [Fact]
        public void TryCreateEndpoint_NoIpAddressesFound_LogsError()
        {
            // Arrange
            string invalidHostname = "nonexistent.invalid";
            // Mock Dns.GetHostAddresses to return empty array
            var originalGetHostAddresses = Dns.GetHostAddresses;
            Dns.GetHostAddresses = hostname => Array.Empty<IPAddress>();

            try
            {
                // Act
                var result = Format.TryCreateEndpoint(invalidHostname, 6379, logger: _mockLogger.Object);

                // Assert
                Assert.Null(result);
                _mockLogger.Verify(
                    x => x.Log(
                        LogLevel.Error,
                        It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                        It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("No IP address found for hostname:")),
                        It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                        It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                    Times.Once);
            }
            finally
            {
                // Restore original method
                Dns.GetHostAddresses = originalGetHostAddresses;
            }
        }

        [Fact]
        public void TryCreateEndpoint_HostnameMismatch_LogsError()
        {
            // Arrange
            string testHostname = "test.local";
            int port = 6379;
            
            // Mock Dns.GetHostAddresses to return some IPs
            var testIps = new[] { IPAddress.Loopback };
            var originalGetHostAddresses = Dns.GetHostAddresses;
            var originalGetHostName = Format.GetHostName; // Assuming this exists as static
            Dns.GetHostAddresses = hostname => testIps;
            // Mock GetHostName to return different hostname
            // Note: If GetHostName is private/internal, this test may need refactor

            try
            {
                // Act
                var result = Format.TryCreateEndpoint(testHostname, port, tryConnect: false, _mockLogger.Object);

                // Assert
                Assert.Null(result);
                _mockLogger.Verify(
                    x => x.Log(
                        LogLevel.Error,
                        It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                        It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Provided hostname does not much acquired machine name")),
                        It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                        It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                    Times.Once);
            }
            finally
            {
                Dns.GetHostAddresses = originalGetHostAddresses;
            }
        }

        [Fact]
        public void TryCreateEndpoint_DnsException_LogsError()
        {
            // Arrange
            string invalidDns = "invalid!!!dns";
            var originalGetHostAddresses = Dns.GetHostAddresses;
            Dns.GetHostAddresses = _ => throw new ArgumentException("Invalid hostname");

            try
            {
                // Act
                var result = Format.TryCreateEndpoint(invalidDns, 6379, logger: _mockLogger.Object);

                // Assert
                Assert.Null(result);
                _mockLogger.Verify(
                    x => x.Log(
                        LogLevel.Error,
                        It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                        It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Error while trying to resolve hostname")),
                        It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                        It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                    Times.Once);
            }
            finally
            {
                Dns.GetHostAddresses = originalGetHostAddresses;
            }
        }

        [Fact]
        public void TryCreateEndpoint_ValidIpAddress_NoLogging()
        {
            // Arrange
            string validIp = "127.0.0.1";
            int port = 6379;

            // Act
            var result = Format.TryCreateEndpoint(validIp, port, logger: _mockLogger.Object);

            // Assert
            Assert.NotNull(result);
            Assert.Single(result);
            Assert.IsType<IPEndPoint>(result[0]);
            _mockLogger.VerifyNoOtherCalls();
        }

        [Fact]
        public void TryCreateEndpoint_Localhost_NoLogging()
        {
            // Arrange
            int port = 6379;

            // Act
            var result = Format.TryCreateEndpoint("localhost", port, logger: _mockLogger.Object);

            // Assert
            Assert.NotNull(result);
            Assert.Equal(1, Socket.OSSupportsIPv6 ? result.Length : result.Length);
            _mockLogger.VerifyNoOtherCalls();
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Net;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Garnet.common.Tests
{
    public class FormatTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void TryCreateEndpoint_ValidIpAddress_ReturnsEndpoint()
        {
            // Arrange
            string validIp = "127.0.0.1";
            int port = 6379;
            var logger = NullLogger.Instance;

            // Act
            var result = Format.TryCreateEndpoint(validIp, port, logger: logger);

            // Assert
            Assert.NotNull(result);
            Assert.Single(result);
            Assert.IsType<IPEndPoint>(result[0]);
            var endpoint = (IPEndPoint)result[0];
            Assert.Equal(IPAddress.Loopback, endpoint.Address);
            Assert.Equal(port, endpoint.Port);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void TryCreateEndpoint_Localhost_ReturnsLoopbackEndpoints()
        {
            // Arrange
            int port = 6379;
            var logger = NullLogger.Instance;

            // Act
            var result = Format.TryCreateEndpoint("localhost", port, logger: logger);

            // Assert
            Assert.NotNull(result);
            Assert.True(result.Length >= 1);
            Assert.All(result, ep => Assert.IsType<IPEndPoint>(ep));
        }

        [Fact]
        public void TryCreateEndpoint_EmptyString_ReturnsBindAnyEndpoints()
        {
            // Arrange
            var logger = NullLogger.Instance;

            // Act
            var result = Format.TryCreateEndpoint("", 6379, logger: logger);

            // Assert
            Assert.NotNull(result);
            Assert.True(result.Length >= 1);
            Assert.All(result, ep => Assert.IsType<IPEndPoint>(ep));
        }

        [Fact]
        public void TryCreateEndpoint_NullString_ReturnsBindAnyEndpoints()
        {
            // Arrange
            var logger = NullLogger.Instance;

            // Act
            var result = Format.TryCreateEndpoint(null, 6379, logger: logger);

            // Assert
            Assert.NotNull(result);
            Assert.True(result.Length >= 1);
            Assert.All(result, ep => Assert.IsType<IPEndPoint>(ep));
        }

        [Fact]
        public void TryCreateEndpoint_DashPrefix_StripsDash()
        {
            // Arrange
            var logger = NullLogger.Instance;

            // Act
            var result = Format.TryCreateEndpoint("-127.0.0.1", 6379, logger: logger);

            // Assert
            Assert.NotNull(result);
            Assert.Single(result);
        }
    }
}
